method: Scenario-based agent responses reviewed in the original authoring conversation. Evaluators shared prior task context and one had helped design the cases. This was not an independent blind evaluation or a replay of real project artifacts.

prompt_corrections.finding: The original scenario did not say whether Corporate Presentation had a Baseline, so the evaluator correctly refused to infer one.
prompt_corrections.correction: State that a current verified Corporate Presentation Baseline exists; the rerun used it and rejected recent Sports Exhibition files.

prompt_corrections.finding: Approved framework components alone do not prove MATURE or Baseline Continuation.
prompt_corrections.correction: State that the framework is the active verified Baseline with representative coverage and validation PASS; the rerun classified MATURE and continued from it.

limitations: The perfect score is the original author's reported assessment, not a reproducible measurement or certification.
Raw model responses and complete evaluator metadata were not retained in this repository, so these scores cannot be independently recomputed here.
One evaluator had designed the cases and both received earlier conversation context; intended answers were therefore not fully blinded.
Two scenarios were clarified and rerun during authoring; case-specific scores were assigned manually.
Private real-project validation is user-reported methodology experience, not independently inspected project evidence in this repository.
Project-specific readability thresholds and coverage dimensions still require project evidence.
The first live use after installation should confirm trigger routing alongside existing presentation skills.
